title: `teploy backup run --all --detach --host S --json` (backup-setup-v1, rev 21): starts the cron line's `backup run --all` on the server, under its flock, and looks at it for about 3 seconds. Later results reach `backup status` and `events` as a normal run's do. Exit 0 for started and already_running; finished exits as the run would have; failed exits nonzero. A binary too old to run it, or a failure to start, uses the error envelope.

status.description: started: still running when it looked. already_running: another run holds the lock and this one stood down. finished: it ended within the first seconds, see result. failed: it ended without a result, see error.

log.description: the run's progress on the server (0600, removed after 14 days)

result.description: with finished: the run's own result, as in backup-run-envelope without machine_interface
